mentat.comment: PLATINUM_RULES §21 — Mentat does the physics. There is ONE Mentat: skippy-core's (the chat model, the router, the DE440 data), over the tailnet; the same server the user-level config names. Tools appear as mcp__mentat__*. Shell equivalent: tools/mentat_call.sh. (Until 2026-10-27 this ran stdio inside a `skippytel-mentat` container on the PC; that container is gone, and this entry shadowed the working user-level one.)
